gaps: No Korean food at all despite the family liking bold, spicy flavours and owning a cast-iron and a wok.
No egg- or paneer-based mains; the vegetarian adult has no high-protein anchor beyond beans and chickpeas.
No Japanese cuisine; ramen and noodle soups are an obvious fit given the family's love of noodle dishes.
No Indian food outside of a single South Indian kanji; North Indian curry is a wide-open lane.
No seafood whatsoever — fish tacos were declined but shrimp/prawn in other formats has never been tried.
The BGE and Ooni are listed equipment but no weekend project recipe uses live-fire or slow-smoke cooking.
No Sichuan or broader Chinese regional cooking; the wok is used but only for Thai-style noodles.

ideas.title: Shakshuka
ideas.why: Adds eggs as a weeknight vegetarian protein and opens up North African / Levantine cooking — a cuisine entirely absent from the collection.

ideas.title: Vegetarian Ramen (Soy Milk Miso)
ideas.why: Brings Japanese cuisine into the rotation for the first time and gives the vegetarian adult a rich, brothed noodle bowl to match the chicken-based soups everyone else enjoys.

ideas.title: Paneer Butter Masala (Restaurant Style)
ideas.why: Fills the total absence of North Indian curry and adds paneer as a new vegetarian protein; the creamy tomato-cashew sauce is reliably kid-friendly.

ideas.title: Mapo Tofu: The Real Deal
ideas.why: Opens up Sichuan cooking and gives the wok a genuine workout; ground pork (which the family eats as bacon) is easily swapped to ground chicken, and tofu adds a new protein the vegetarian adult can eat in a meatless version.

ideas.title: Prawn (Shrimp) Stir Fry
ideas.why: Introduces seafood — the only protein type completely missing from the collection — in a fast wok format the cook already handles well.

ideas.title: Dakgalbi (Korean Spicy Chicken Stir-Fry)
ideas.why: Adds Korean cuisine for the first time and is a one-pan cast-iron dish built for a crowd — boneless skinless chicken thighs, chewy rice cakes, gochujang sauce, and cabbage cook in under 30 minutes.
